# mcphound

> Independent security reputation site for public Model Context Protocol
> (MCP) servers. Every score comes from static analysis only — mcphound
> never installs, executes, or connects to a server to produce a finding.
> Findings map to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM and Agentic applications.

Rescanned nightly against the official MCP Registry. A server's score is
100 minus a multiplicative decay per finding (see /faq); 100 means no
findings in the current snapshot, not an audit guarantee.

## Site

- [Flagged servers](https://mcphound.dev/): servers currently scoring
  below 100, worst first.
- [Full registry](https://mcphound.dev/browse/1): every scanned server,
  paginated, with its current score.
- [Typosquat watchlist](https://mcphound.dev/typosquats): known MCP
  packages paired with any one- or two-character lookalike published on
  the registry.
- [FAQ](https://mcphound.dev/faq): how the score is computed, what counts
  as a finding, and how to dispute one.

## Project

- [Source and CLI](https://github.com/markdoyle4312-hash/mcphound): the
  `mcphound` scanner (also on PyPI), rule catalog, and this site's code.
- [Rule catalog](https://github.com/markdoyle4312-hash/mcphound/blob/main/docs/rules.md):
  every detection rule with its OWASP mapping.
- [Policy enforcement](https://github.com/markdoyle4312-hash/mcphound/blob/main/docs/policy.md):
  `mcp-policy.yaml` allowlisting for CI.
